scope.heading: Scope
scope.body: This statement covers the popyplan-panel web panel (this site, served under this same domain) and the Popyplan mobile app (iOS and Android). It does not cover embedded third-party content (for example, images or documents uploaded by an entity) or sites linked outside these two products.

status.heading: Compliance status
status.body: This site is partially compliant with level AA of the UNE-EN 301549:2022 Standard (WCAG 2.1), due to the exceptions described in «Non-accessible content». It will become «fully compliant» once the automatic audit (axe) and manual keyboard tests cover every page without documented exceptions (Phase 6, task W5 of this panel).

nonAccessible.heading: Non-accessible content
nonAccessible.intro: As of this statement, the following panel pages don't yet have a dedicated automatic accessibility test (axe) — the coverage chosen so far is representative of the three areas and the shared patterns (tables, dialogs with focus trapping, charts, forms), but not exhaustive:
nonAccessible.list: Communities, Activities, Reports, On-call, Settings, Announcements, Surveys and Resources of the entity panel; Reports of the umbrella entity panel; and Audit log, Help, Verifications, Roles, Reports, Metrics and entity record of the platform panel. Extending this coverage is mechanical work, documented in CLAUDE.md («Accessibility»).

preparation.heading: Preparation of this statement
preparation.body: This statement was prepared on September 5, 2026. It was reviewed through automatic evaluation (axe-core on the pages with a dedicated test, see «Non-accessible content») and manual keyboard and screen reader review of the main flows across the panel's three areas.

contact.heading: Feedback and contact details
contact.body: You can report any accessibility problem, or request information in an accessible format, by writing to <email>{contactEmail}</email>.

procedure.heading: Enforcement procedure
procedure.body: If after contacting us you don't get a response or aren't satisfied with it, you can file a complaint under article 13 of <rd>Royal Decree 1112/2018</rd>.
